research_question: Which strictly pre-open, D-1-or-earlier features differ between sessions where close exceeds open and sessions where close does not exceed open, and which mechanically distinct model hypotheses should be frozen before reading the later confirmation outcomes?

authority.reason: This stage deliberately inspects only the fixed discovery window. A separate remote confirmation protocol must freeze hypotheses, models, gates, and code before any 2024-11-01-or-later candidate outcome is scored.

frozen_input.source: 19 official JPX monthly stock-price-table PDFs already hash-locked by model_v05_input_lock.json

point_in_time_contract.label: 1 when same-session close > open, otherwise 0 when the outcome is observed
point_in_time_contract.feature_latest_source: the immediately preceding completed official session
point_in_time_contract.nonconsecutive_history: window feature is missing rather than bridging a missing official session

lagged_spectrum.normalization: subtract the 32-value median and divide by 1.4826 times median absolute deviation; use an all-zero normalized path when scale is zero
lagged_spectrum.transform: real FFT after normalization, discard the DC bin, and use squared magnitude as energy

bin_contract.low_energy_ratio: energy in bins 1 through 4 divided by total non-DC energy
bin_contract.high_energy_ratio: energy in bins 9 through 16 divided by total non-DC energy
bin_contract.spectral_entropy: entropy of the 16 normalised energies divided by log(16)
bin_contract.dominant_frequency: largest-energy bin index divided by 16; zero when total energy is zero

definitions.oc_sign_transition_rate_20: mean of sign(oc[t]) != sign(oc[t-1]) over 19 adjacent pairs
definitions.oc_turning_rate_20: fraction of 18 interior points whose adjacent first differences have a negative product
definitions.oc_permutation_entropy_20: normalised entropy over the six stable-sort ordinal patterns of every consecutive length-3 OC tuple
definitions.oc_abs_autocorr_20: Pearson correlation of adjacent absolute OC returns; zero when either side has zero variance
definitions.am_pm_sign_agreement_20: mean of sign(AM return) == sign(PM return)
definitions.am_pm_return_corr_20: Pearson correlation of AM and PM returns; zero when either channel has zero variance
definitions.component_sign_entropy_20: entropy divided by log(27) over the 27 exact sign patterns of AM, lunch, and PM returns
definitions.range_abs_oc_ratio_20: sum(range percent) divided by sum(abs(OC return)); zero when the denominator is zero

comparison.primary_scale: within-date percentile rank among valid eligible rows
comparison.primary_effect: equal-date mean of mean(feature rank | close > open) minus mean(feature rank | close <= open)
comparison.uncertainty: two-sided normal approximation from the standard error of daily rank gaps

stable_signal_rule.slice_sign: all three fixed discovery slices must have the same non-zero sign as the aggregate

comparison.ordering: absolute primary rank gap descending, then feature name ascending

allowed_hypothesis_families_after_discov.mechanism: low-rank Dynamic Mode Decomposition of completed cross-stock price states
frequency-domain path representation with a small deterministic neural readout
path-complexity representation with a class-conditional Gaussian generative model

must_include: feature selection rule applied to this discovery result
cost, temporal, tail, code concentration, and execution gates

stop_rule: Run the 53-feature discovery contrast once. Do not add, remove, redefine, or reorder features after viewing the result. Do not read or score any 2024-11-01-or-later candidate outcome until a separate confirmation protocol and implementation are committed remotely.
